_doc: Touge race (Gordon [godot], touge-race, Austin go-ahead 2026-11-19). Shared by Godot and tools/parity_touge.py. No balance numbers here: stats come from scripts/globals.gd (TODO(barry) parity blocks), rules from sim/ by name.
_track_doc: corners = sim/config/tracks_v1.json tracks.touge.T1_Akina_Switchbacks, the lap match.race_setup uses by default for Touge (first official track). tools/gen_globals.py asserts they match.
_max_turns_doc: race length in turns = corners = 10; kappa = kappa_for_length(10) (KAPPA_BY_LENGTH x KAPPA_HEAT_MULT)
_dir_doc: corner direction is display-only (lane tell side). tracks_v1 carries no L/R; PLACEHOLDER alternation.
_opponent_doc: Austin: test rival is the Touge kid (P1's rung). Rung name from LADDER_RUNGS; the stat block is the same TODO(barry) parity placeholder as every car (Austin 2026-11-19: car choice is visual only).
_qte_window_mod_doc: MatchConfig.qte_window_mod default 0.0. No mods in this test.
_opponent_qte_ratio_doc: MatchConfig.opponent_qte_ratio (Austin approved 2026-11-19). Mean raw AI QTE = OPPONENT_QTE (0.80) × this. 1.0 is the live default (same as omitting it). Per-turn draw uses OPPONENT_QTE_SD/MIN/MAX from its own RNG seeded race_seed + OPPONENT_QTE_SEED_OFFSET (104729). Optional overrides: opponent_qte_sd / _min / _max.
_use_draft_blocks_doc: true = Barry's car blocks, unapproved/barry/touge-race-parity/blocks.json @ fd59332 (still UNAPPROVED; globals.gd CAR_DRAFT_BLOCKS). false = the TODO(barry) even/equal placeholder for every car. Settings per that file: 10 turns, touge, no mods, no retune, opponent QTE ratio 1.0 (= OPPONENT_QTE).
_touge_passing_doc: Touge passing (sim 5c79dea, Austin approved 2026-11-20 6:00 PM PT): no lead/chase roles and no turn-5 swap. Per-phase scoring follows sim equations.PER_PHASE_DISTRICTS (globals.gd); optional "per_phase": true/false forces it (MatchConfig.per_phase). The start formation is display only (display.json visual_gap.touge).
